subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Technology often makes people think about safety, but it can also help people see good actions.”?
options: It can begin when someone notices a small waste and says something.
But it showed that change becomes easier when people can see it, count it, and do it together.
A small camera showed that someone had done the right thing when no one seemed to be watching.
The reef was small in the tank, but it showed a large idea: protecting one habitat can protect many lives at once.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Technology often makes people think about safety, but it can also help people see good actions. A small camera showed that someone had done…」，答案為「A small camera showed that someone had done the right thing when no one seemed to be watching.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A small camera showed that someone had done the right thing when no one seemed to be watching.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
